$comment: Nebraska ingest scope. VERIFIED 2026-08 by scripts/probe-ne.mjs. The Legislature serves one plain HTML page per section at laws/articles.php?article=<ROMAN>-<section> — note the section is part of the `article` parameter, and that `?article=III` alone returns a 200 with a 37-byte empty body rather than a 404, so a status-code check alone proves nothing. Scope is deliberately one clause: Art. III Sec. 1 is why Nebraska is here at all. It vests the legislative authority in a Legislature of one chamber, adopted by initiative in 1934 and effective 1937, which makes Nebraska the only state that answers the one-group-or-two question differently from the other forty-nine.
